observations: A black Sony PlayStation 4 console, original 'fat' model.
The top plate features a Darth Vader/Star Wars graphic, characteristic of the Limited Edition Star Wars Battlefront bundle.
Two DualShock 4 controllers are visible on top of the console.
The console has a matte finish on the left side and a glossy finish on the right (Darth Vader side), suggesting a CUH-1200 series model.
A watermark 'SNYZ GADGET HOME' is present on the image.

read_from: photo 0 (PS logo and PS4 text on the side)

claims.evidence: no photo of the system menu or game library

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware failure (e.g., Blue Light of Death) or a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up to the dashboard and launching a game.

risks.risk: The 'installed games' may be digital and tied to a personal account that the buyer will not be able to keep.
risks.proof: Confirmation that the seller is providing the account details or that the games are physical discs.

risks.risk: The controllers may have 'analog stick drift' or failing batteries.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or a controller test app.

risks.risk: The storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game.
Photo of the 'System Storage' screen in the settings menu.
Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.
Clear photos of the controllers' condition, especially the thumbsticks.
response.reason: The item is identified as a Sony PlayStation 4. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional, base storage, no games) until further proof of operation and account status is provided.
